trust_properties.name: Deterministic scheduling under concurrency
trust_properties.description: Ready-queue evolution and dispatch tie-breaking are deterministic for identical inputs.

trust_properties.name: Failure propagation correctness
trust_properties.description: Downstream node state and terminal run status reflect dependency failures without silent success.

trust_properties.name: Replay equivalence and divergence detection
trust_properties.description: Equivalent runs are recognized and non-equivalent runs produce explicit mismatch evidence.

trust_properties.name: Cache integrity and invalidation
trust_properties.description: Cache hits require valid proofs and stale or corrupted entries are rejected.

trust_properties.name: Artifact integrity and lineage
trust_properties.description: Artifact commits, lineage links, and manifest evidence remain coherent and tamper-visible.

trust_properties.name: Policy enforcement and safety denials
trust_properties.description: Policy-denied operations fail safely and produce explicit policy-classified failures.

trust_properties.name: Operator observability quality
trust_properties.description: Run inspection surfaces provide concise and complete debugging evidence under failure.

trust_properties.name: Import/export and compatibility strictness
trust_properties.description: Bundles and run artifacts round-trip only when schema and compatibility requirements hold.

trust_properties.name: State-machine transition legality
trust_properties.description: Node and run states never regress through illegal transitions in terminal paths.

trust_properties.name: Timeout and retry accounting
trust_properties.description: Timeouts and retries are bounded, classified, and reflected in run outcomes.

trust_properties.name: Secret redaction and leakage prevention
trust_properties.description: Sensitive values are redacted in logs, traces, manifests, and panic payloads.

trust_properties.name: Run-directory resilience under corruption
trust_properties.description: Malformed or corrupted run directories are rejected with explicit diagnostics.

trust_properties.name: Plan truth and lowering determinism
trust_properties.description: Semantically equivalent graphs lower to identical execution plans and unsupported requirements fail during planning.

trust_properties.name: Config and policy determinism
trust_properties.description: Config precedence, policy merge, and effective debug surfaces resolve deterministically across execution and inspection.
